items.verbatim_quote: CI Financial embarked on a "new strategic direction in November 2019" (E-078, CI Financial acquisition press release) organized around three priorities that continue to govern subsidiary technology investments:

grounding.representative_quote: SBH’s strategic direction is shaped by two layers: (1) parent-company mandates from CI Financial/Corient, and (2) firm-level business objectives defined within the active Zennify engagement.

items.title: SBH’s strategic direction is shaped by two layers: (1) parent-company mandates from CI…
items.verbatim_quote: SBH’s strategic direction is shaped by two layers: (1) parent-company mandates from CI Financial/Corient, and (2) firm-level business objectives defined within the active Zennify engagement. Understanding both layers is critical for framing DMA recommendations.

grounding.representative_quote: SO1 — Modernizing its asset management: Standardizing technology platforms across CI’s acquired RIAs.

items.title: SO1 — Modernizing its asset management: Standardizing technology platforms across CI’s acquired…
items.verbatim_quote: SO1 — Modernizing its asset management: Standardizing technology platforms across CI’s acquired RIAs. The FSC migration is a direct expression of this objective — aligning SBH’s Salesforce org with Corient’s FSC architecture. (E-078, INT-001:F4)

grounding.representative_quote: SO2 — Expanding its wealth management: Growing the U.S. wealth management footprint through 14+ acquisitions since 2020.

items.title: SO2 — Expanding its wealth management: Growing the U.S…
items.verbatim_quote: SO2 — Expanding its wealth management: Growing the U.S. wealth management footprint through 14+ acquisitions since 2020. SBH was the largest by asset size. The Corient platform now manages $224B in aggregate client assets. (E-078, INT-005)

grounding.representative_quote: SO3 — Globalizing the company: CI Financial operates across Canada, U.S., and Australia.

items.title: SO3 — Globalizing the company: CI Financial operates across Canada, U.S., and Australia…
items.verbatim_quote: SO3 — Globalizing the company: CI Financial operates across Canada, U.S., and Australia. The Mubadala take-private brings Abu Dhabi sovereign capital and global institutional relationships. (E-078)
